name: Messe-Hub — Daten fürs Dashboard (V1 adapted, do not import live)

nodes.name: Daten anfordern
nodes.notes: V1: header auth only; same credential MUST NOT be reused by WF-A/B/C/D. No wildcard CORS.

parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.lead_id, s.created_at, s.processing_status, s.duplicate_status, s.review_required,
         co.company_name, ct.contact_name, r.score_band
  FROM trade_fair.lead_submissions s
  JOIN trade_fair.companies co ON co.company_id = s.company_id
  LEFT JOIN trade_fair.contacts ct ON ct.contact_id = s.contact_id
  LEFT JOIN trade_fair.processing_results r ON r.lead_id = s.lead_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ranked)::bigint AS total,
       COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE x.lead_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) AS leads
FROM (
  SELECT lead_id, created_at, processing_status, duplicate_status, review_required,
         company_name, contact_name, score_band
  FROM ranked
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT $2::int OFFSET $3::int
) x;

postgres.name: WBS Trade Fair — Neon PostgreSQL (dashboard reader)

nodes.notes: V1: least-privilege Neon role; SELECT-only on lead_submissions, companies, contacts and processing_results. No new grants; must match the role already used by WF-A/B/C/D (same credential object, not reused secret for Dashboard webhook auth).

parameters.content:
## Messe-Hub Dashboard V1 (adapted)

- Webhook: POST /webhook/messe-hub/dashboard-leads (header auth only).
- No wildcard CORS; only the gateway may call this.
- Allowlist response: lead_id, created_at, company_name, contact_name, processing_status, score_band, duplicate_status, review_required.
- No notes, no email/phone, no raw payloads, no AI/company research.
- Pagination clamped: page 1-10000, limit 1-50.
- DO NOT IMPORT INTO LIVE n8n WITHOUT OWNER APPROVAL AND A SEPARATE SCOPED HEADER-AUTH CREDENTIAL.
